name: Susaki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Susaki city emblem in navy: a stylised device of two curled strokes enclosing a stylised letter W.
history: Municipal flag of Susaki, a city in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Susaki city emblem — a stylised device of two curled strokes enclosing a stylised letter W
